# linear_custom_view (Data Source)

Looks up a Linear custom view by UUID or name.

Reading the filter of an existing view is the quickest way to work out what to put in a `linear_custom_view` resource's `filter_json`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linear_custom_view" "in_review" {
  name = "In Review"
}

# Reading an existing view's filter is the quickest way to work out what to put
# in a linear_custom_view resource's filter_json.
output "filter" {
  value = data.linear_custom_view.in_review.filter_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) UUID of the view. Set either this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the view. Set either this or `id`. Ambiguous when several views share a name — look those up by id.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) Colour of the view icon as a hex string.
- `description` (String) Description of the view.
- `feed_item_filter_json` (String) Feed item filter as Linear stores it, normalised.
- `filter_json` (String) Issue filter as Linear stores it, normalised.
- `icon` (String) Icon of the view.
- `initiative_filter_json` (String) Initiative filter as Linear stores it, normalised.
- `model_name` (String) What the view lists — `Issue`, `Project`, `Initiative` or `FeedItem`.
- `owner_id` (String) UUID of the user who owns the view.
- `project_filter_json` (String) Project filter as Linear stores it, normalised.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the view is visible to the whole workspace.
- `team_id` (String) UUID of the team the view is scoped to, null for a workspace-wide view.
